title: POTV XMAX Starry V4 Accessories Kit
description:
Replacement Battery

Skip the charge times with a spare battery for your Starry V4. This battery is rated at 3500 mAh for long-lasting performance wherever you are. Keep one fully charged and when you need it, skip the wait times and jump right back into your session with a quick and easy swap.

XMAX Starry Water Pipe Adapter

Inhale the Starry’s vapor through your favorite tabletop glass bubbler with the Starry Water Pipe Adapter. This whip-style adapter connects one end to the Starry’s swivel mouthpiece and the other to your bubbler. This is a must-have accessory for maximum effectiveness with the Starry V4.

XMAX Starry Dosing Capsule 5-Pack

Prepack multiple sessions with this pack of dosing capsules for the Starry vaporizer. Pack your sessions with precise amounts everytime or pre-pack them to chain multiple sessions together with minimal downtime. Messes are also contained to just the capsule so they’ll keep your vape fresher for longer too!

Dosing capsule travel tube included.

XMAX Silicone Glove for Starry V4

Add a layer of style and protection to your Starry V4 with this Silicone Sleeve. This sleeve fits snug around your Starry V4 for added grip and padding against light bumps and falls. And it looks cool!

Return policy

We do not accept used accessories to be returned on their own. Your items are eligible to be returned through our 30-day policy if they are unused and unopened.

See more of our XMAX Parts and Accessories.
